name: tanitjobs-bot
description: Personal job-alert bot for TanitJobs — Firestore + Telegram, run as a scheduled GitHub Actions workflow.

scripts.verify:emulator: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "node dist/db/emulator-check.js"
scripts.deploy:job: node -e "console.log('No separate deploy step — deployment is git push. .github/workflows/collect.yml is the schedule; set repo secrets ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY.'); process.exit(0)"
